description: This file 'DataElement.cpp' contains implementation code for CRC32 checksum calculation, buffer management, and data copying functionalities within the WPEFramework Core namespace, specifically for DataElement and LinkedDataElement classes.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Implements CRC32 checksum calculation for data buffers.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Manages linked buffer segments with methods for buffer access, modification, and copying between linked elements.

methods.name: DataElement::CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified segment of the data buffer.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::GetBuffer
methods.description: Copies a segment of the buffer at a given offset, handling boundary crossing via linked segments.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::SetBuffer
methods.description: Writes data to the buffer at a specified offset, managing cross-boundary scenario with linked segments.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another linked data element into this one, starting at a specified offset, across linked segments.

methods.name: uint32_t CRC32(const uint64_t offset,const uint64_t size) const
uint64_t Copy(const uint64_t offset,const LinkedDataElement & copy)
void GetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,uint8_t * buffer) const
void SetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,const uint8_t * buffer)
